title: Go
notes:
But my boldest ambition is none of this, its for creators.
        In todays inescapable interconnectedness, constant - sometimes undesired - tracking and a perpetual pursuit for performance:
        I have been researching this union within a consumer content management tool that maps all motion and moments.
        Creators need autonomous assemble a story of a day, week, year or life to make more of their free time.
        Creators need photorealistic, collaborative play back of their journeys to share with their friends online.
        Creators should use a GlobeView as a landing interface that continues to allow vis.gl to shine.

Route Planner / Location Tracker
Adventure → Video Automation
Go is for planning.

points: The boldest ambition: build for creators
Map motion and moments in one content tool
Assemble a day, a week, a year or a life
